title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
review: I watched every Friday the 13th movie to prepare for this. And I'm glad I did. All those hours of suffering were worth it so that I could enjoy this. The intro/title sequence alone is so fun. Having said that, I think I prefer the concept over the execution. I wanted it to be a little more of a horror movie, but it gets increasingly metaphorical and then ends abruptly. All the horror scenes are blunted by being in fictional movies within the movie.
